opening.argument: The speaker promotes BitClub as a way to earn Bitcoin through mining-pool shares and referral activity, while tying additional income to the activity of people in a participant's team. The plan requires sponsoring five miners who each sponsor two more, and describes credits when someone buys a $500 share in mining pools. Viewers are invited to join for a $99 fee, alongside claims of everyday Bitcoin-mining profits. The records do not verify mining activity, actual payouts, or what occurs after joining.

citations.quote: when you first join everyone is called a minor. As soon as you sponsor 5 miners so that's 5 people here the people in blue and they each sponsor 2 miners themselves
you can receive an additional income from the people in your team that are also receiving binary bonuses
If someone buys a $500 dollar share in mining pool 1 in mining pool two you receive one credit.
